scope: macOS target mouse report compatibility, optional absolute-coordinate refresh, and two CH9329 adapters; no automatic display correction.

setup.display: Mirrored; final settled MCP trials used 1920x1080 Cocoa points at scale 1. USB/video restarts temporarily changed the logical primary display; raw gesture dimensions are recorded separately.

method.input: Real autopaws-mcp screenshot coordinates through candidate autopaws-kvm; separate raw serial experiments establish sustained holds.
method.observation: Native AppKit NSView event callbacks, NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons changed-state samples, and a selectable noneditable NSTextView containing fixed test text.
method.coordinate_units: Cocoa logical points with primary top-left origin; screenshot coordinates match only after display settlement.
method.transfer: Local bounded telemetry, one expiring public paste upload per run; no screen contents or keyboard telemetry retained here.
method.build_scope: Earlier mode-2 and replacement-adapter physical trials used the first candidate with refresh enabled unconditionally. A final original-adapter mode-0 MCP run used the opt-in flag and verified get_device_info.config.mouse_absolute_refresh=true. Default-off legacy sequences and config wiring are also covered by automated tests.

adapters.name: replacement
adapters.original_50_configuration_bytes: Identical to original adapter; separately read back after the aborted no-op reset gate.

released_baseline.repeated_same_absolute: Ignored; distinct absolute coordinate followed by exact destination restored position.

issue_107.result: Optional coordinate refresh restores repeated absolute destinations and positions before new absolute button presses.

issue_106_original_mode_0.absolute_buttons: Press registered, but changing absolute coordinates caused a native release despite held report masks.
issue_106_original_mode_0.duplicate_report_button_masks: Holding the same button on both report types did not preserve the native hold.
issue_106_original_mode_0.relative_move_with_unchanged_absolute_bu: Preserved a roughly five-second native hold and grew selected text from zero to three characters.
issue_106_original_mode_0.relative_count_limit: 30 counts moved 25.7109375 Cocoa points in this run; relative counts cannot be treated as screenshot pixels.
issue_106_original_mode_0.final_flag_run: Default relative-button click/drag still failed. Absolute-button click produced one native down/up pair at the exact requested point; atomic absolute drag selected seven characters but the global button was already zero at the endpoint. Refresh does not repair this hold loss.

issue_106_replacement_mode_0.positioned_absolute_click: One native down/up pair at the requested point.
issue_106_replacement_mode_0.absolute_button_atomic_drag: Selected seven characters, but a sustained global hold was not captured. This does not establish continuous drag/drop compatibility.
issue_106_replacement_mode_0.mode_2_attempt: Aborted before setting mode 2 because a no-op reset of the original configuration omitted the expected reset acknowledgement. Separate readback verified all 50 original bytes unchanged.

optional_original_adapter_mode_2.meaning: CH9329 USB working mode 2, not a USB standard, not serial protocol mode 2, and not a manufacturer-independent requirement.
optional_original_adapter_mode_2.mutation: Changed only byte 0 of the saved 50-byte configuration from 80 to 02; serial protocol mode 0 and 9600 baud preserved.
optional_original_adapter_mode_2.restoration: All 50 original configuration bytes read back exactly after every completed original-adapter trial; official v0.7.1 daemon restored after candidate trial.

limits: No specific retail cable manufacturer is required; two adapters sharing a descriptor and chip vendor still behaved differently.
Mode 2 was validated only on GET_INFO version 38; it was not entered on version 34.
The optional refresh does not repair lost button holds or alter USB descriptors.
No extended-display reconfiguration was requested for these mouse checks.
USB/video restart temporarily changed primary logical dimensions; the first absolute sample in the final mode-2 run was taken before settlement and is not an exact-position pass.
Native text selection and sampled holds establish these gestures only, not all applications or drag/drop interactions.
No additional Windows/Linux physical run of refresh-enabled behavior; default-off report sequences retain legacy regression coverage.
Apple driver source suggests a report aggregation/digitizer interaction; that is an inference, not proof of the running macOS driver path.

adapter_api_validation.limits: Persistent API changes were temporary for validation and exactly restored. API mode changes were physically tested only on firmware byte 38; other adapters may fail the no-op gate. No new target display arrangement was requested.
